question: Does the speed curve under a clip look and move the way you want?
context: Reel: queue/audits/2026-10-17-speed-curve-reel.gif (and .mp4), contact sheet 2026-10-17-speed-curve-reel-contact.png, app beside the mock 2026-10-17-speed-curve-beside-the-mock.png. Measured in the walk: every band'"s

options.label: Keep it: band wash under the line, swatch strip on the floor
options.summary: The cyan line runs over a wash tinted by speed (pink where fast, cyan where slow, purple at normal) with a solid strip of the legend colours along the bottom, a freeze hatched amber.
pros: Fast, slow and frozen read at a glance without the legend
The strip gives the exact mock colours
cons: Busier than the mock, whose wash under the line is one faint cyan
options.mitigation: The wash is light (a fifth strength) so the line and diamonds stay on top.

options.label: Quieter: one faint cyan wash, as the mock draws it
options.summary: Only the strip along the floor carries the band colours; under the line is the mock's single faint cyan.
pros: Calmer next to the clips above
cons: Where the clip is fast reads only from the thin strip
options.mitigation: The clip bar itself will carry the bands once its own task lands.

options.label: Bolder: colour the line itself by band
options.summary: No wash; the line changes colour along its length (pink where fast, cyan where slow, amber where frozen), with the strip on the floor.
pros: The line itself says the speed
cons: Loses the mock's single cyan line
Thin coloured line is harder to see on dark

answer.note: Taken as recommended: the user, 2026-10-19, said there were too many cards, most did not matter and they could not follow them. Change it later only if they complain about the result
